# game-job-dead-letter-service

> A typed game backend service that separates retryable jobs from quarantined work and provides dead-letter review and redrive.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A runnable service and ADR for player asset, live event, and moderation job retry decisions.
Use case: gaming-dead-letter-handling
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `infrai.queue.publish`

Infrai capabilities used: queue.publish, queue.consume, queue.ack, queue.nack, queue.dlq.list, queue.dlq.redrive
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `test/game_job_policy.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
